A '''sapper droid''' was a type of droid that could drain energy from shield generators. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] deployed them against the [[Imperial Garrison (Corellia)|Imperial Garrison]] in [[Axial Park]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]].
